recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Tryptophan is an essential amino acid: humans cannot build the indole ring, so the whole supply is dietary. Both the melatonin and 5-HTP rows depend on this substrate, and because tryptophan hydroxylase runs below saturation, raising tryptophan is the physiological lever on serotonin synthesis, with the pathway's own regulation left intact. The one genuinely endogenous route worth stating runs downstream: hepatic conversion to niacin.

recovered_entries.supplement: Adaptogens, medicinal mushrooms and high-volume polyphenols: Panax ginseng, Eleutherococcus, cordyceps, reishi, chaga, turkey tail, curcumin, resveratrol, quercetin
recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Ginsenosides, eleutherosides, cordycepin, ganoderic acids, fungal beta-glucans, curcuminoids, stilbenes and flavonols are all plant or fungal metabolites with no human pathway, so the axis is silent across the group; adaptogen is a marketing category, not a pharmacological class. Beta-glucans are the partial exception in interest rather than origin, since humans have receptors for them (CLEC7A/dectin-1, CR3) but no synthesis. The three polyphenols share one practical problem: extensive first-pass glucuronidation and sulfation, so plasma aglycone is very low and formulations exist mainly to defeat that metabolism.

NONE here means the same thing it means for caffeine and quercetin, which is that the axis is silent and the entire case has to be made pharmacologically, on human outcome data these ingredients mostly lack.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 任何动物都不合成这些植物成分，所以标为 NONE，但这个 NONE 不含任何需求含义：withanolides、protodioscin、葫芦巴皂苷及其同类都没有需求量，也没有缺乏状态。这里的 NONE 与咖啡因和槲皮素处的含义相同，即这条轴不作判断，全部论证只能落在药理学上，而这些成分大多缺少相应的人体结局数据。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE in humans, no biosynthetic pathway exists for any of these compounds. recovered_entries.pathway_zh: 在人体 NOT APPLICABLE，这些化合物都没有对应的生物合成途径。植物以类异戊二烯和固醇骨架合成它们 (withanolides 来自甲羟戊酸和固醇途径，protodioscin 等固醇皂苷来自胆固醇衍生的皂苷元)。人体的相关酶学只有 I 相和 II 相代谢，以及肠道微生物对糖基部分的水解。

recovered_entries.still_matters_when: NEVER ON THIS AXIS. An analysis of best-selling online testosterone-boosting supplements found most ingredient claims unsupported by human data, with some products carrying very large vitamin and mineral doses (PMID 30621919, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12). Ashwagandha has separate stress and sleep literature that should be judged on its own outcome data, not on an endogenous-synthesis argument.
recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 在这条轴上 NEVER。一项针对网络热销睾酮增强类补剂的分析发现，多数成分宣称缺乏人体数据支持，部分产品还含有极大剂量的维生素和矿物质 (PMID 30621919, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12)。南非醉茄在压力和睡眠方面有独立文献，应按其自身的结局数据评判，与内源合成的论证无关。
recovered_entries.source: PMID 30621919 (Balasubramanian A et al., Testosterone imposters: an analysis of popular online testosterone boosting supplements, J Sex Med 2019;16:203-12)

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Three conditionally essential compounds: the body makes them, and named states make that synthesis insufficient. Taurine is made in liver from cysteine, but human cysteine sulfinic acid decarboxylase activity is low compared with rodents, which is why taurine is treated as conditionally essential in preterm infants, in long-term parenteral nutrition and in some hepatic disease. Arginine is made through the intestinal-renal axis, where enterocytes produce citrulline and the kidney converts it to arginine, and it becomes limiting in trauma, sepsis, burns, rapid growth and renal failure. recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Four labels are used, and adequate quantity is judged against basal physiological function at the tissue's normal set point, not against a storage ceiling and not against the dose a trial happened to use. FULL: the human pathway is complete and output covers basal need in health. PARTIAL: the pathway exists but output is structurally capped below what the relevant pool or function needs, so dietary supply routinely contributes. CONDITIONAL: output covers basal need in health and falls short in named states, which must be named. NONE: no human biosynthetic pathway, which includes every chemical element, since no o ...
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 全表用四个标签, 判断供应是否充足的基准是健康状态下组织在正常设定点的基础生理功能, 不按储存池上限, 也不按某项试验所用剂量。FULL: 人体通路完整, 健康时自身产量覆盖基础需要。PARTIAL: 通路存在, 但产量在结构上被限制在相关池或功能所需之下, 饮食供应经常性参与。CONDITIONAL: 健康时够用, 在明确点名的状态下不够用。NONE: 人体完全没有该生物合成通路, 所有化学元素都归此类, 因为没有生物能合成元素。标签是描述性的: NONE 不含需求含义 (caffeine 和 quercetin 是 NONE 且无需求, vitamin C 和 zinc 是 NONE 但有需求也有缺乏症), FULL 也不能判定药理剂量是否有效 (melatonin 即是)。

recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Use the axis to decide whether a product has a target, then use pharmacology and trial evidence to decide whether it works. The axis can kill a premise (glucosamine, collagen as a molecule, test boosters) and it can support one (creatine, beta-alanine, vitamin C at low intake, B12 in a vegan). It never settles efficacy on its own.
